_comment: Paste ONE of these into your marketplace repo's .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
'plugins' array. Which one depends on how that marketplace lists its plugins.
vendored: use when the marketplace lists its plugins by a relative './' path, so
the plugin has to live inside the marketplace repo. Copy it there with
which also inserts or updates this entry for you. Re-run it after any change to
plugin/ (or wire it into CI), otherwise users keep the copy they already have.
referenced: use when users add the marketplace themselves with
'/plugin marketplace add'. Nothing is copied and nothing needs re-syncing -- the
marketplace points at this repo's plugin/ subdirectory and every push to the branch
reaches everyone. Deliberately no 'sha': pinning one freezes the plugin forever.
Neither form carries a 'version', matching plugin.json. A versioned plugin is only
re-delivered when the version is bumped.

vendored.name: gelpy
vendored.description: Analyze gel electrophoresis images end-to-end with the gelpy CLI: place lanes from the image itself, remove background, fit per-lane band intensities, and produce a browsable run folder with results.csv, a report, and per-lane fit plots. Encodes the verify-as-you-go loop -- detect lanes, confirm the overlay, fit, inspect every lane, refit the stragglers.
